specialist_trace.rationale: The documentation must explicitly describe purulent findings—such as otorrhea, purulent drainage, or a bulging tympanic membrane with visible pus—to support the “化脓性” (suppurative) specificity, as the current exam only notes erythema and bulging without suppuration. Without these details, the diagnosis cannot be accurately coded as acute suppurative otitis media.
